operatorDecision.supersedes: Active cancel must preserve Pi-queued follow-ups. Native active Stop withdraws queued inputs; submit replacement only after Stop.

selectedImplementation: PiHarness + Lifecycle; retained celld 0.6.1; nodejs_compat; native inbox, steering and Stop

items.issue: Node-free worker bundle fails on node:async_hooks and node:diagnostics_channel
items.approach: Use celld nodejs_compat and carry compatibility flags into the later host fixture

items.issue: Implement the thin Effect bridge to native follow-up, steer, queued withdrawal and session Stop
items.approach: Use official public APIs. Keep company authority, command digest/mode checks, approval binding, tool receipts and product projection in Cerebro. Project all affected operation IDs when native Stop settles them. Do not rebuild the Pi inbox, dispatcher or Lifecycle alarms. Map joined steering operation IDs to shared execution and one canonical answer in the authorized product projection.
items.evidence: evidence/wrapper-timeline.json; native semantics cases in qualification.json; original stronger Stop requirement remains FAIL with operator-approved semantics change

items.issue: Idle eviction and individual Cerebro command intent/acceptance/projection crash boundaries
items.approach: Inject each crash on retained host. Reuse Pi stable submission IDs and official wake/recovery; acknowledge only after native acceptance is recorded. Do not add a host execution queue.

items.issue: Production bucket durability and flush before queued acknowledgment
items.approach: Repeat with production-equivalent storage configuration; local celld-dev restart cannot prove remote durability

items.issue: Provider retries, compaction, current model authority and Effect interruption reaching provider/tool
items.approach: Use controlled physical counters and cancellable provider/tool signals; bound cancellation work so a Lifecycle job cannot stall unrelated jobs

items.issue: Approval across eviction, denied/revoked approval zero physical dispatch and uncertain-write reconciliation
items.approach: Keep authority, approval binding and unknown-outcome receipts enforced; verify with real host and controlled tool counters

items.issue: Snapshot attachment race, observer overflow and real browser approval/reconnect/access generations
items.approach: Implement the proposed public hydrate/joinRun lifecycle and canonical resnapshot; complete browser cases

items.issue: Application manifests, catalogs, lockfile, root test aliases and AG-UI package metadata remain unapplied
items.approach: Apply dependency-requests.json in one owner commit and run fresh application checks

items.issue: No codex/cerebro-slice-1 integration branch for a packet PR
items.approach: Create the reviewed integration baseline when starting later packets; use this branch SHA for review now

items.issue: Replacement interruption and retry between native abort and submit; real-host changed-input/mode conflict enforcement
items.approach: Use the existing Cerebro command journal with immutable mode/input and replacement phase. Before retrying Stop inspect the original replacement operation; an accepted replacement retry must not abort itself or later work. Serialize conflicting human command mutations. Inject crashes before/after Stop and Pi acceptance. The fixture replace route qualifies only the ordered two-call sequence, not durable replacement retries.
items.evidence: Contract fakes pass phase/replay/conflict checks; real-host replacement crash/duplicate command cases remain NOT_RUN.

items.issue: Earlier 45-second functional test ended before celld default 60-second cold-alarm discovery scan
items.approach: Use a 90-second no-HTTP functional window with the default host scan; require an idle snapshot and saved answers before observation, then verify both operations settled. Retain official PiHarness startup/resume and Lifecycle alarms. Production storage and separate idle eviction remain T04/T03; the S1-F 60-second performance budget remains NOT_RUN.
